question: GQ-006
subject: three of the four unverified vault databases, verified
the_blocker_was_the_check_form: I recorded four databases as "skipped, too slow on USB" after full pragma quick_check exceeded ten minutes. quick_check(1) bounds the error count and returns in seconds — the same integrity signal for a first failure, at a fraction of the cost. The constraint I recorded as file size was partly my choice of pragma.

still_unverified.reason: Exceeds ten minutes even with quick_check(1). Size is genuinely the constraint here, not the pragma.
still_unverified.what_it_does_have: A banded checksum across 250,005 rows in five bands spanning first to last rowid, run earlier today, all matching the live index.

honest_note: 11 of 12, not 12 of 12. The passage index has stronger evidence than a quick_check anyway — a content comparison against the live database — but it has not had a structural integrity check today and I am not going to claim otherwise.
